question: What decision currently governs single-file script dependency metadata? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: PEP-722 is currently the active governing decision for dependency specification in single-file scripts.
The authority evidence for PEP-722 is documented at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/08d688fdcafc1557bf7fc53573e5c84b31b78b5d/peps/pep-0722.rst.
